name: Great Ships and Famous Wrecks
description: Longships, flagships, liners and wrecks: the vessels that crossed oceans, won wars and went down, and what they tell us.

checkpoints.name: Oars and sails
checkpoints.note: Egyptian barges, Greek triremes, Viking longships and Chinese treasure ships show how many cultures took to the water long before Columbus.

checkpoints.name: The age of sail
checkpoints.note: Caravels and galleons cross oceans, and wrecks such as the Mary Rose and the Vasa remind us how risky early warships and voyages were.

checkpoints.name: Steam and iron
checkpoints.note: Iron hulls, propellers and steam engines change the sea. Brunel's giant ships, the first ironclads, the Dreadnought and the Titanic belong to this age.

checkpoints.name: War and wrecks
checkpoints.note: Two world wars bring the sinking of liners and giant battleships, while the Endurance and Mary Celeste become stories of survival and mystery.

checkpoints.name: Boxes and atoms
checkpoints.note: Container ships remake world trade and nuclear submarines open the poles, while retired liners find new lives as museums.
